hero_eyebrow: Free to start · Runs in your browser · Nothing is uploaded
hero_title_b: and clean up photos in seconds
hero_lead: Resize, crop, convert formats, and remove backgrounds from your photos. Every image is processed locally in your browser — nothing is ever sent to a server.
drop_sub: or click to browse · JPG, PNG, WEBP
footnote: Erase or restore parts of the photo by hand with the wand, brush, lasso, and polygon tools — no AI, everything stays on your device.
crop_hint: Drag on the photo to select the area you want to keep.
removebg_hint: Use the wand, brush, lasso, or polygon tool to manually erase or restore parts of the photo.
removebg_error: Something went wrong, please try another photo.
how_lead: No settings to configure. Drop a photo, pick a tool, download the result.
step1_desc: Drag and drop, or choose from your device. Your photo never leaves it.
step2_desc: Resize, crop, convert the format, or remove the background.
step3_desc: Get your edited photo in one click, ready to use anywhere.
bgr_polygon_hint: Click to add points, then close the shape
bgr_polygon_help: Click to place points around an area, then close the shape.
bgr_lasso_help: Drag to draw a freehand selection around an area.
bgr_wand_help: Click a color to select similar pixels around it.
bgr_brush_help: Drag to paint over the areas you want to erase or restore.
